notifications.title: Bluebird v1.8 Is Here! 🚀
notifications.body: The long-awaited Bluebird v1.8 is officially released! Explore new apps, the Bluebird App Store, web app installation, live wallpapers, improved media controls, Word Impress, and much more. Update through Settings or visit bluebirduganda.dpdns.org.

notifications.title: Bluebird Is Back! 💙
notifications.body: After our development pause, the Bluebird team is back at work. Our team is working hard to bring better productivity, new ideas, and an even better Bluebird experience. Thanks for staying with us!

notifications.title: 💡 Bluebird News of the Day
notifications.body: Great software is built one improvement at a time. Today, we're celebrating a new release and a fresh start for Bluebird. More is on the way!
